word: Title: Evening At The Neighborhood Market
answer: Tarde En El Mercado Del Barrio

word: I send a quick message to my sister.
answer: "Envío un mensaje rápido a mi hermana."

word: You prepare your shopping list. [sing, inf]
We present our coupons at the counter.
They finish choosing vegetables for dinner.
answer: "Terminan de escoger verduras para la cena."

word: I start walking toward the fruit section.
answer: "Inicio el camino hacia la sección de frutas."

word: You visit the bakery for fresh bread. [pl]
We allow the kids to pick one snack.
answer: "Permitimos que los niños elijan una botana."

word: They receive samples of new products.
You sell handmade soaps at a small stand. [sing, formal]
We understand the prices on the signs.
I answer the vendor’s question politely.
answer: "Respondo la pregunta del vendedor con cortesía."

word: They study the labels for ingredients.
answer: "Estudian las etiquetas para ver los ingredientes."

word: You meet your friend near the fruit aisle. [sing, inf]
answer: "Cumples con ver a tu amigo cerca del pasillo de frutas."

word: We care about buying fresh produce.
I wish for a calm evening at the market.
answer: "Deseo una tarde tranquila en el mercado."

word: They enjoy the smell of warm bread.
You save a few pesos with your coupons. [pl]
She improves her recipe with new spices.
We note the best prices for next time.
answer: "Notamos los mejores precios para la próxima vez."

word: They see the vendor observing the crowd.
answer: "Observan al vendedor ver a la gente."

word: You deliver the basket to the cashier. [sing, formal]
I send the receipt to my phone.
We mention the sale to our neighbors.
They inform the customers about a discount.
answer: "Informan a los clientes sobre un descuento."

word: You explain your recipe to a friend. [sing, inf]
I am going to prepare dinner soon.
They are going to visit another stand.
We are going to finish shopping quickly.
